verdict.rationale: A GPU's developer ecosystem (CUDA toolkit, SDKs) could plausibly offer an interactive API reference, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an interactive, runnable API reference for the RTX PRO 6000 or its toolkit. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. The build.nvidia.com inference endpoints belong to a separate hosted-model service, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
